reason: A DSH plugin for running independent parallel agent conversations in a side panel and selectively bringing summarized results back into the main conversation.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 侧边面板中运行独立的并行智能体会话，并将会话摘要选择性带回主对话。
summaries.en: Runs independent parallel agent sessions in a DSH side panel and selectively brings their summaries back to the main conversation.

capabilities: Creates and manages parallel agent sessions
Sends user messages to side agent sessions
Allows side agents to use the inherited tools and shared workspace
Injects summarized side-session results into the main conversation
Provides a browser side-panel interface and RPC/API routes
